jobs.description: Give your career a new dimensionCore mission:The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for fundamental research using neutrons. The ILL operates the brightest neutron source in the world and hosts over 2000 visits by scientists per year, who come to carry out world-class research.Within the Applied Science group (AS, 18 people) of ILL's Science Division, you will act as instrument technician for the new ThRILL thermal neutron imaging instrument, which will enter user operation in 2027, and TENIS, an irradiation instrument serving academic and industrial needs.Your tasks:In this context, you will:- Ensure the smooth operation and maintenance of ThRILL and TENIS, which are located in building ILL5, level C, at the reactor neutron source.- Coordinate the work of ILL services involved in these activities.- Assist the ILL scientists responsible for ThRILL and TENIS with the preparation and conducting of experiments, typically together with scientific and industrial users.- Propose technical improvements and, where appropriate, implement these improvements with the assistance of ILL services.-Help to ensure compliance with ILL and instrument safety regulations, in particular radiation protection regulations.-Become a valued member of the Applied Science group and support your colleagues and users where needed and appropriate.Your profile:- You have a Level 4-6 qualification (e.g. BTEC HNC/HND, undergraduate degree or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, applied physics and instrumentation or equivalent.-You have at least two years of professional experience in the same area.-You have experience in the manufacture, assembly and alignment of precision mechanical, electronic and optical assemblies.-You are proficient in the use of CAD software.-Ideally, you also have some knowledge of computing, electronics and electricity to allow you to take part in other technical projects.-You have a practical approach to your work and are keen to learn new skills.-You are an excellent team player but are also capable of working independently on a wide variety of projects.- You are able to work meticulously and provide support to in-house and visiting scientists.What we offer:Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more information, please visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditionSounds interesting?Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal by 22.11.2026, quoting reference number 26/50.Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness for work under ionising radiation is required.We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) is based in Grenoble (France) and operates Europe's leadingresearch facility for basic research with neutrons. United by our passion for progress andtechnology, we drive science and research forward every day. Together, we can pave the wayfor discoveries that will help to make our world a better place.www.ill.eu/careers

Job Description:  Airbus Helicopters' ambition is to make Vertical Lift the best choice to save lives, protect people, connect cities and reach any place. The Airbus Helicopters' Data Strategy aims to deeply transform how we manage data within a highly complex and fragmented landscape, paving the way for the onboarding of future technologies. To drive this vision, the Data, Analytics and AI Team has created the Centre of Excellence (CoE) Data & Analytics. The challenge of AH Data Governance organization within the Centre of Excellence D&A is to drive the company to maximize data readiness for value creation in compliance. We are supporting business with methods, tools and animation of key data topics, such as the deployment of a data community, the set-up of the company data catalog, the acceleration of access to data, the guidance about data protection and compliance, etc. -----------The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment.You will live a unique professional experience, at the heart of the manufacturing of our helicopters.To learn more about our site and our activities:  Airbus Helicopters - Marignane ------------- A position as Lead Data Architect has just opened within Data Governance in Marignane. The job holder will lead the enterprise viewpoint for how data assets should be structured and used to deliver prioritized business outcomes, translating business strategy into data and analytics architecture and implementation guidance. The Lead Data Architect will lead the enterprise viewpoint for how data assets should be structured and used to deliver prioritized business outcomes, translating business strategy into data and analytics architecture and implementation guidance. You will be responsible for the following main activities:  Provide the technical roadmap and scalable architecture needed to translate the Airbus Helicopters Data Strategy to action, ensuring the foundation is reliable and AI-ready.  Define and enforce a unified catalog of approved technologies (bricks) to promote standardization and prevent architectural fragmentation.  Coordinate the D&A architecture community of practice and provide oversight of solution architecture, data architecture and data engineering to ensure consensus on definitive models and platforms.  Ensure that the architectural roadmap is aligned with the Enterprise Architecture's corporate strategy and risk mandates.  Guide tool selection and integration (catalogs, active metadata, data quality tooling) by defining metadata requirements before procurement and by prioritizing people/process readiness for adoption.  Data Modeling: Lead the design of complex relational and non-relational data models to support both transactional and analytical topics. jobs.description: Technician for lab management and user supportCONTEXT: The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) is an international centre for scientific research situated in Grenoble, France. It is Europe's leading neutron science facility. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research in a wide variety of scientific fields. The Biology, Deuteration, Chemistry and Soft Matter (BDCS) group operates the Chemistry and Soft Matter support laboratories, which offer equipment, lab space and support for sample preparation and characterisation, serving both external users and in-house scientists. The BDCS group also operates the Lipid and Deuteration laboratories, which are equipped with state-of-the-art instrumentation for the production and characterisation of tailor-made deuterated biological molecules for the ILL user community.YOUR TASKS:In the context of the European FEDER EPN-AVENIR-ILL project and the arrival of new laboratory equipment in the BDCS group, you will reinforce the team in the management of the different labs, support the users with their scientific projects, including the activities of the ILL Science Hubs, and liaise between the members of the group. You will welcome and interact with users before, during and after their stay, assist with operating equipment, and help with sample preparation. Your activities will include:. Supporting the scientists and lab managers by communicating with, welcoming and assisting users with their scientific projects in the different labs. Management of laboratory supplies and stocks, and regular calibration of lab equipment. Organisation of lab space and equipment, as well as participation in waste management and the chemical inventory. Supporting the Lipid Lab staff with the user programme, in particular with running the chromatography equipment (HPLC, GC, TLC,.), including the new FEDER equipment. The successful candidate will interact with various actors at ILL, including members of the BDCS group, safety engineers, technicians, as well as ILL users and external companies.YOUR PROFILE:You have a Level 5 qualification (HND or equivalent) in chemistry (or biochemistry). Expertise in the operation of standard (bio-)chemistry laboratory equipment. Sound knowledge of laboratory safety rules and regulations. Autonomy and good communication skills. Experience of working in a research facility, in industry or at a large-scale research infrastructure would be an asset. You must have a sound knowledge of written and spoken English. Knowledge of French would be a plus (a language course could be paid for by the ILL)QUALITY OF LIFE: This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!
